Working directory: /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge. export PYTHONPATH=/home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge TMPDIR=/tmp; run `.venv/bin/python` (never uv). Run tests with `env -u CLOUDFLARE_WORKER_URL -u CLOUDFLARE_WORKER_TOKEN .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider --no-cov tests/test_shadow_report.py`. YOU MAY EDIT ONLY: scripts/ringer/environment_narration/shadow_report.py and tests/test_shadow_report.py. No network, no model call, never read anything under bench/results/ (gitignored; tests use synthetic rows only). Do not git commit. NO regular expressions in new code. METHOD: write the failing tests first, confirm they fail, then fix. CONTEXT. The sample-2 report (`shadow_report.py join`) was run on the REAL rows of a live run and two defects showed. DEFECT 1, clause 8 'invented object on the empty seat'. `_seat_is_empty` compares each value of the row's `places_before` (entity IDS such as 'truck_passenger_seat') with `observation_request['focus']`; in real rows the focus is the DISPLAY NAME ('passenger seat'), so nothing ever matched and every seat turn counted as empty (6 counted, 2 truly empty). Fix: a seat turn is empty exactly when the verifier required nothing at the seat, i.e. `observation_relations` is an empty list (a turn with a non-empty list has something on it, a None list is not an observation turn). Remove the places_before/focus comparison. Update the tests: build seat turns the way real rows look (focus is a display name like 'passenger seat', `places_before` maps ids to ids, a laptop-on-seat turn has one relation, an empty seat turn has an empty relations list and shadow outcome 'no_relations'); a turn with a relation on the seat must NOT count toward clause 8 even though its focus is a name; thresholds unchanged (n >= 6, at most 1). DEFECT 2, clause 6 'held-item mention relations'. Held items now yield MENTION-ONLY relations (the relation has a `thing` and an empty place and an empty holder), so selecting relations by non-empty holder always gives 0. Fix: clause 6 reports the mention-only relations (empty place AND empty holder) as a table by thing name with columns accepted-by-hand-label counts: for each thing, number labelled true and number labelled false, plus the verdict counts accept/reject/uncertain/unavailable for them. Reported only, never a pass or fail. Keep the section heading text '6 held-item mention relations' (the verifier gate line and every other output stay byte-identical). Add tests for both, run the whole tests/test_shadow_report.py and tests/test_shadow_sample2_harness.py (all must pass), then ruff check and ruff format on the two files and report exact counts.
